prisoners.name: Jennifer Moriarty
prisoners.description: Jennifer Moriarty is an Evanston attorney detained by federal immigration agents on October 31, 2025 after approaching with her phone to record their treatment of a motorist following a collision. She described being tackled, handcuffed and driven around in an SUV. She told the Chicago Tribune that she was allowed to leave more than five hours later at an FBI field office. A federal court opinion independently records her detention and release without charges.

cases.sentence: More than five hours detained, according to her Chicago Tribune interview; released without charges. No conviction or sentence. Exact release calendar date remains unset. Sources: https://www.pulitzer.org/winners/staff-chicago-tribune (Bizarre behavior section); https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/district-courts/illinois/ilndce/1:2025cv12173/487571/281/ (November 20, 2025 opinion, pages 154-157). The opinion discusses the three Evanston detainees collectively and identifies Moriarty individually. Its injunction was subsequently stayed and the underlying suit voluntarily dismissed; the profile does not present that injunction as currently operative.
